items.title: Meta stock falls on Q2 earnings miss: What's next for capex?
items.summary: Meta (META) reported second quarter results on Wednesday after the closing bell. Earnings per share (EPS) came in at $6.18 (compared to analyst estimates of $7.14), and revenue came in at $60.80 billion (compared to analyst estimates of $60.24 billion). Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré takes a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: S&P 8,500 melt-up? Why money is leaving big tech
items.summary: Trader Talk host Kenny Polcari, Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild, and Payne Capital Management President Ryan Payne break down the market's massive rotation out of big tech, the reality of AI infrastructure spending, and the bold case for an S&P 8,500 melt-up by year-end.

items.title: Why Meta Platforms (META) Is Down 6.6% After AI Costs Squeeze Q2 Profitability And What's Next
items.summary: Meta Platforms has reported its Q2 2026 results, with revenue rising to about US$60.80 billion from US$47.52 billion a year earlier, while net income fell to around US$15.85 billion and diluted EPS dropped to US$6.18 amid sharply higher costs.
